blind.order: How Connecticut orders its count has not been seen here, so the first figures may lean either way. The model never treats the first figures as typical: it compares each county counted with what the forecast expected there, and lets the ballots still to come lean differently from those counted so far.
roll: Not every voter marks every race. How many are likely to skip this one is part of the model's expected vote.
pos: The order of names on this state's ballots is not measured here, so the model gives no candidate an edge for being listed first.

inputs: Replays of the 2024 general in 5 states, each counted in its own order, two of them read a second time as totals only (us-live-1.1)
